cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Driving a motor vehicle” and ends with “requires a driver license”?
cards.back: Driving a motor vehicle on Kansas public roads requires a driver license.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A new Kansas resident must” and ends with “of moving into the state”?
cards.back: A new Kansas resident must obtain a Kansas driver license within ninety days of moving into the state.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An applicant must” and ends with “age and address”?
cards.back: An applicant must provide proof of name, age and address.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Applicants below” and ends with “guardian consent”?
cards.back: Applicants below eighteen need parental or guardian consent.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Applicants must surrender driver” and ends with “cards they previously held”?
cards.back: Applicants must surrender driver licenses or identification cards they previously held.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An applicant with suspended, revoked,” and ends with “under the handbook's eligibility list”?
cards.back: An applicant with suspended, revoked, denied or cancelled driving privileges is disqualified under the handbook's eligibility list.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Kansas licensing requires” and ends with “the United States”?
cards.back: Kansas licensing requires lawful presence in the United States.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Applicants must meet the” and ends with “their requested license type”?
cards.back: Applicants must meet the medical conditions for their requested license type.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Unpaid moving-violation fines” and ends with “listed licensing requirements”?
cards.back: Unpaid moving-violation fines prevent meeting the listed licensing requirements.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The passenger-car handbook does not” and ends with “commercial-vehicle manual for commercial licensing”?
cards.back: The passenger-car handbook does not replace the separate commercial-vehicle manual for commercial licensing.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Motorcycle licensing requires study of” and ends with “in addition to this handbook”?
cards.back: Motorcycle licensing requires study of the separate motorcycle manual in addition to this handbook.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook includes a court” and ends with “meeting its licensing eligibility list”?
cards.back: The handbook includes a court finding of mental incompetence among the conditions that prevent meeting its licensing eligibility list.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A Class C license permits” and ends with “below twenty-six thousand one pounds”?
cards.back: A Class C license permits a vehicle whose gross vehicle weight rating is below twenty-six thousand one pounds.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An internet driver-education completion” and ends with “accepted for Kansas licensing”?
cards.back: An internet driver-education completion certificate is not accepted for Kansas licensing.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Kansas-approved school-district driver education must” and ends with “with Department of Education approval”?
cards.back: Kansas-approved school-district driver education must come from an accredited district with Department of Education approval.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An approved private” and ends with “eight classroom hours”?
cards.back: An approved private driver-education program provides eight classroom hours.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An approved private driver-education” and ends with “hours of behind-the-wheel instruction”?
cards.back: An approved private driver-education program includes six hours of behind-the-wheel instruction.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An applicant below eighteen must” and ends with “the applicant's Kansas licensing path”?
cards.back: An applicant below eighteen must complete approved driver education when that requirement applies to the applicant's Kansas licensing path.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A Kansas non-commercial Class C” and ends with “to be at least fourteen”?
cards.back: A Kansas non-commercial Class C instructional permit requires the applicant to be at least fourteen.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An instructional-permit applicant younger than” and ends with “parent's or guardian's written application”?
cards.back: An instructional-permit applicant younger than sixteen needs a parent's or guardian's written application.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A parent or guardian signs” and ends with “the licensing office when applying”?
cards.back: A parent or guardian signs the instructional-permit affidavit at the licensing office when applying.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a Class C instructional” and ends with “driver-education course you are attending”?
cards.back: For a Class C instructional permit, pass the vision and written exams or bring the DE99 form authorizing the permit from the approved driver-education course you are attending.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A Class C instructional permit” and ends with “may be renewed with testing”?
cards.back: A Class C instructional permit expires after one year and may be renewed with testing.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An instructional-permit holder may drive” and ends with “licensed adult seated in front”?
cards.back: An instructional-permit holder may drive only with a licensed adult seated in front.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The adult supervising an” and ends with “be at least twenty-one”?
cards.back: The adult supervising an instructional-permit driver must be at least twenty-one.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The adult supervising an instructional-permit” and ends with “one year of driving experience”?
cards.back: The adult supervising an instructional-permit driver needs at least one year of driving experience.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The supervising adult is the” and ends with “seat beside an instructional-permit driver”?
cards.back: The supervising adult is the only person permitted in the front seat beside an instructional-permit driver.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An instructional-permit driver may use” and ends with “activity or obtaining emergency assistance”?
cards.back: An instructional-permit driver may use a wireless device only for reporting illegal activity or obtaining emergency assistance.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A farm-permit applicant must” and ends with “and younger than seventeen”?
cards.back: A farm-permit applicant must be at least fourteen and younger than seventeen.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A farm-permit applicant must live” and ends with “have paid employment on one”?
cards.back: A farm-permit applicant must live on a farm or have paid employment on one.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For the farm-permit rule, a” and ends with “acres devoted to agricultural use”?
cards.back: For the farm-permit rule, a farm has at least twenty acres devoted to agricultural use.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A farm employer must” and ends with “the applicant's farm employment”?
cards.back: A farm employer must sign an affidavit confirming the applicant's farm employment.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The farm-permit process requires an” and ends with “or guardian and the employer”?
cards.back: The farm-permit process requires an affidavit signed by a parent or guardian and the employer.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A farm-permit applicant must pass” and ends with “the DE-ninety-nine driver-education completion slip”?
cards.back: A farm-permit applicant must pass vision, written and driving exams or present the DE-ninety-nine driver-education completion slip.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A farm-permit driver aged fourteen” and ends with “employment or other farm-related work”?
cards.back: A farm-permit driver aged fourteen or fifteen may drive for farm work, employment or other farm-related work.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A farm-permit driver aged fourteen” and ends with “attend school, excluding school activities”?
cards.back: A farm-permit driver aged fourteen or fifteen may use the most direct home-school route to attend school, excluding school activities.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Farm-permit drivers aged fourteen or” and ends with “passengers who are not siblings”?
cards.back: Farm-permit drivers aged fourteen or fifteen may not carry minor passengers who are not siblings.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A farm-permit driver may use” and ends with “activity or request emergency help”?
cards.back: A farm-permit driver may use a wireless device only to report unlawful activity or request emergency help.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Before receiving the lesser farm-permit” and ends with “at least fifty practice hours”?
cards.back: Before receiving the lesser farm-permit restrictions for ages sixteen and seventeen, an applicant needs a parental or guardian affidavit confirming at least fifty practice hours.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The farm-permit practice affidavit for” and ends with “at least ten nighttime hours”?
cards.back: The farm-permit practice affidavit for lesser restrictions must include at least ten nighttime hours.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Farm-permit holders under the lesser” and ends with “five a.m. and nine p.m”?
cards.back: Farm-permit holders under the lesser restrictions may drive between five a.m. and nine p.m.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may” and ends with “school and authorized school activities”?
cards.back: A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may travel to or from school and authorized school activities.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may” and ends with “held by a religious organization”?
cards.back: A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may travel to or from an activity held by a religious organization.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Lesser-restricted farm-permit driving is” and ends with “employment and farm-related duties”?
cards.back: Lesser-restricted farm-permit driving is permitted for work, employment and farm-related duties.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may” and ends with “occupies the front passenger seat”?
cards.back: A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may drive while a licensed adult occupies the front passenger seat.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The lesser-restricted farm-permit path allows” and ends with “outside the driver's immediate family”?
cards.back: The lesser-restricted farm-permit path allows only one minor passenger from outside the driver's immediate family.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A farm-permit applicant below seventeen” and ends with “one year before license issuance”?
cards.back: A farm-permit applicant below seventeen must have held a state learner permit for at least one year before license issuance.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At age sixteen, holding a” and ends with “removes the listed age restrictions”?
cards.back: At age sixteen, holding a lesser-restricted license or farm permit for six months removes the listed age restrictions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For less-restricted farm-permit practice at” and ends with “must be at least twenty-one”?
cards.back: For less-restricted farm-permit practice at age sixteen, the accompanying adult must be at least twenty-one.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license” and ends with “least fifteen”?
cards.back: A restricted-license applicant must be at least fifteen.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license applicant must have” and ends with “on a driver-education permit slip”?
cards.back: A restricted-license applicant must have held a state learner permit for at least one year, excluding time on a driver-education permit slip.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license applicant” and ends with “supervised practice hours”?
cards.back: A restricted-license applicant aged fifteen needs twenty-five supervised practice hours.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Restricted-license applicants aged fifteen must” and ends with “do not have that requirement”?
cards.back: Restricted-license applicants aged fifteen must complete approved driver education, while applicants aged sixteen do not have that requirement.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Restricted-license applicants aged” and ends with “supervised practice hours”?
cards.back: Restricted-license applicants aged sixteen need fifty supervised practice hours.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Of the practice required for” and ends with “hours must be at night”?
cards.back: Of the practice required for restricted-license applicants aged sixteen, ten hours must be at night.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A parent or guardian must” and ends with “the restricted-license applicant's supervised practice”?
cards.back: A parent or guardian must attest by affidavit to the restricted-license applicant's supervised practice.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged fifteen” and ends with “for ages sixteen and seventeen”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged fifteen with only twenty-five supervised hours must submit another affidavit for twenty-five additional hours, including ten at night, before moving to the restrictions for ages sixteen and seventeen.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For the restricted Class C” and ends with “must be at least twenty-one”?
cards.back: For the restricted Class C practice requirement at age fifteen, the accompanying adult must be at least twenty-one.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For the less-restricted Class C” and ends with “must be at least twenty-one”?
cards.back: For the less-restricted Class C practice requirement at age sixteen, the accompanying adult must be at least twenty-one.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license applicant aged sixteen” and ends with “the DE-ninety-nine driver-education completion slip”?
cards.back: A restricted-license applicant aged sixteen must pass the vision, written and driving exams or present the DE-ninety-nine driver-education completion slip.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged fifteen” and ends with “job, employment or farm work”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged fifteen may travel for a job, employment or farm work.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged fifteen” and ends with “for attendance, excluding school activities”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged fifteen may take the direct home-school route on school days for attendance, excluding school activities.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged fifteen” and ends with “held by a religious organization”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged fifteen may travel directly to or from an activity held by a religious organization.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged fifteen” and ends with “licensed adult sits in front”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged fifteen may drive when a licensed adult sits in front.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Restricted-license drivers aged fifteen” and ends with “who are not siblings”?
cards.back: Restricted-license drivers aged fifteen may not carry minors who are not siblings.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver may use” and ends with “activity or summoning emergency help”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver may use a wireless device only for reporting unlawful activity or summoning emergency help.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged sixteen” and ends with “five a.m. and nine p.m”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged sixteen may drive between five a.m. and nine p.m.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged sixteen” and ends with “school and authorized school activities”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged sixteen may travel to or from school and authorized school activities.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged sixteen” and ends with “from a religious organization's activity”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged sixteen may travel directly to or from a religious organization's activity.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged sixteen” and ends with “work, employment or farm duties”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged sixteen may drive for work, employment or farm duties.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged sixteen” and ends with “a licensed adult in front”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged sixteen may drive while accompanied by a licensed adult in front.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A restricted-license driver aged sixteen” and ends with “who is not a sibling”?
cards.back: A restricted-license driver aged sixteen may carry only one minor passenger who is not a sibling.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “After reaching age sixteen and” and ends with “restrictions described in the handbook”?
cards.back: After reaching age sixteen and holding a restricted license for six months, the driver is released from all age-related driving restrictions described in the handbook.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The department recommends arranging” and ends with “visiting a licensing office”?
cards.back: The department recommends arranging an appointment before visiting a licensing office.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Eligible Kansas applicants may complete” and ends with “avoid the office knowledge exam”?
cards.back: Eligible Kansas applicants may complete the non-commercial knowledge exam online and bring the passing result to avoid the office knowledge exam.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A license applicant may take” and ends with “a licensed ophthalmologist or optometrist”?
cards.back: A license applicant may take station vision screening or present the Driver Licensing eye-examination form completed within the previous ninety days by a licensed ophthalmologist or optometrist.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Station vision screening requires at” and ends with “forty vision in one eye”?
cards.back: Station vision screening requires at least twenty over forty vision in one eye.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Drivers who need corrective lenses” and ends with “requiring those lenses whenever driving”?
cards.back: Drivers who need corrective lenses to meet the vision standard receive a restriction requiring those lenses whenever driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An applicant who fails vision” and ends with “a licensed ophthalmologist or optometrist”?
cards.back: An applicant who fails vision screening must have the licensing eye form completed by a licensed ophthalmologist or optometrist.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Returning the eye form within” and ends with “license or require further testing”?
cards.back: Returning the eye form within ninety days of examination lets licensing staff decide whether to issue a license or require further testing.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The Kansas knowledge exam covers” and ends with “by shape, color or symbol”?
cards.back: The Kansas knowledge exam covers traffic law and sign recognition by shape, color or symbol.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The driving exam uses a” and ends with “to demonstrate basic vehicle-operation skills”?
cards.back: The driving exam uses a designated traffic route to demonstrate basic vehicle-operation skills.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Graduated licensing introduces beginner drivers” and ends with “stages after initial lower-risk experience”?
cards.back: Graduated licensing introduces beginner drivers to more complex situations in stages after initial lower-risk experience.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “After the first, second or” and ends with “payment of the re-exam fee”?
cards.back: After the first, second or third failure of the written or driving exam, next-working-day retesting is available after payment of the re-exam fee.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook lists a” and ends with “dollar and fifty cents”?
cards.back: The handbook lists a re-examination fee of one dollar and fifty cents.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Applicants receive four” and ends with “the written exam”?
cards.back: Applicants receive four opportunities to pass the written exam.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Applicants receive four” and ends with “the driving exam”?
cards.back: Applicants receive four opportunities to pass the driving exam.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A fourth failure of either” and ends with “the latest failure before retesting”?
cards.back: A fourth failure of either exam requires waiting at least six months from the latest failure before retesting.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An applicant receives a license” and ends with “meeting the other licensing conditions”?
cards.back: An applicant receives a license only after passing the required exams and meeting the other licensing conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Renewing an instructional” and ends with “written exam again”?
cards.back: Renewing an instructional permit requires passing the written exam again.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Kansas lists seventeen as the” and ends with “unrestricted non-commercial Class C license”?
cards.back: Kansas lists seventeen as the minimum age for an unrestricted non-commercial Class C license.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Applicants younger than eighteen seeking” and ends with “at least fifty practice hours”?
cards.back: Applicants younger than eighteen seeking an unrestricted license need a parent or guardian affidavit confirming at least fifty practice hours.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The unrestricted-license practice affidavit for” and ends with “at least ten nighttime hours”?
cards.back: The unrestricted-license practice affidavit for applicants below eighteen must include at least ten nighttime hours.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An unrestricted-license applicant must pass” and ends with “gold DE-ninety-nine driver-education completion slip”?
cards.back: An unrestricted-license applicant must pass vision, written and driving exams or present the gold DE-ninety-nine driver-education completion slip.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A temporary resident's license, permit” and ends with “expires when lawful-presence authorization expires”?
cards.back: A temporary resident's license, permit or identification card expires when lawful-presence authorization expires.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The Division sends a license-expiration” and ends with “least thirty days before expiration”?
cards.back: The Division sends a license-expiration or renewal notice at least thirty days before expiration.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Renewal notices use the mailing” and ends with “address selected for electronic notices”?
cards.back: Renewal notices use the mailing address on record or the email address selected for electronic notices.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For renewal, a licensed ophthalmologist's” and ends with “days before the renewal application”?
cards.back: For renewal, a licensed ophthalmologist's or optometrist's eye examination may replace station screening if completed no more than ninety days before the renewal application.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A licensing examiner may require” and ends with “vehicle control is in doubt”?
cards.back: A licensing examiner may require a renewal applicant to take a written or driving test when ordinary vehicle control is in doubt.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook lists” and ends with “of one dollar”?
cards.back: The handbook lists an additional expired-license penalty of one dollar.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A license expired for more” and ends with “vision, written and driving testing”?
cards.back: A license expired for more than one year requires vision, written and driving testing.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A Kansas license may generally” and ends with “of the holder's Kansas residence”?
cards.back: A Kansas license may generally be renewed at any state driver-license office regardless of the holder's Kansas residence.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Registered offenders must” and ends with “station for renewal”?
cards.back: Registered offenders must use a full-service station for renewal.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A separate-card concealed-carry license holder” and ends with “or license-number changes are needed”?
cards.back: A separate-card concealed-carry license holder may renew at any station if no name, address or license-number changes are needed.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Information on a renewal” and ends with “lead to additional testing”?
cards.back: Information on a renewal eye-examination form may lead to additional testing.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook says a” and ends with “on the holder's birthday”?
cards.back: The handbook says a driver's license expires on the holder's birthday.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

decks.module: Suspension and revocation in the cited handbook

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Three moving-violation convictions within” and ends with “cause a license suspension”?
cards.back: Three moving-violation convictions within twelve months can cause a license suspension.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a first chemical-test” and ends with “requires a one-year suspension”?
cards.back: For a first chemical-test refusal, the handbook requires a one-year suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Failure to appear for a” and ends with “indefinite suspension under the handbook”?
cards.back: Failure to appear for a required court date carries an indefinite suspension under the handbook.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Failure to keep continuous” and ends with “carries an indefinite suspension”?
cards.back: Failure to keep continuous vehicle liability insurance carries an indefinite suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Impaired driving or an alcohol-test” and ends with “or higher can cause suspension”?
cards.back: Impaired driving or an alcohol-test result of point zero eight or higher can cause suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Transporting an” and ends with “cause suspension”?
cards.back: Transporting an open alcoholic-beverage container can cause suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Failure to report” and ends with “can cause suspension”?
cards.back: Failure to report a traffic crash can cause suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A vehicular-homicide conviction” and ends with “revoked driving privileges”?
cards.back: A vehicular-homicide conviction can result in revoked driving privileges.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A conviction for leaving a” and ends with “and helping can cause revocation”?
cards.back: A conviction for leaving a crash involving injury or death without stopping and helping can cause revocation.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A reckless-driving” and ends with “cause revocation”?
cards.back: A reckless-driving conviction can cause revocation.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A conviction for a felony” and ends with “can result in license revocation”?
cards.back: A conviction for a felony committed using a motor vehicle can result in license revocation.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A conviction for trying” and ends with “officer can cause revocation”?
cards.back: A conviction for trying to evade a police officer can cause revocation.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An aggravated-vehicular-homicide” and ends with “license revocation”?
cards.back: An aggravated-vehicular-homicide conviction can result in license revocation.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A vehicular-battery” and ends with “license revocation”?
cards.back: A vehicular-battery conviction can result in license revocation.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a second chemical-test” and ends with “requires a two-year suspension”?
cards.back: For a second chemical-test refusal, the handbook requires a two-year suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a third chemical-test” and ends with “requires a three-year suspension”?
cards.back: For a third chemical-test refusal, the handbook requires a three-year suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a fourth chemical-test” and ends with “requires a ten-year suspension”?
cards.back: For a fourth chemical-test refusal, the handbook requires a ten-year suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Failure to respond to a” and ends with “state can cause license suspension”?
cards.back: Failure to respond to a traffic citation from Kansas or another state can cause license suspension.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A student who lives outside” and ends with “in Kansas from age sixteen”?
cards.back: A student who lives outside Kansas and is classified as nonresident for tuition purposes may drive on a valid license in Kansas from age sixteen.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Active-duty military members and qualifying” and ends with “in Kansas from age sixteen”?
cards.back: Active-duty military members and qualifying spouses and children may drive on a valid license in Kansas from age sixteen.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An employee aged sixteen or” and ends with “receive or provide job instruction”?
cards.back: An employee aged sixteen or older of a company licensed to do business in Kansas may use a valid license while temporarily employed in Kansas to receive or provide job instruction.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Foreign tourists, teachers and business” and ends with “sixteen with valid immigration documents”?
cards.back: Foreign tourists, teachers and business visitors staying up to one year may use a valid license from age sixteen with valid immigration documents.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A nonresident visitor with a” and ends with “in Kansas from age sixteen”?
cards.back: A nonresident visitor with a valid state license may drive in Kansas from age sixteen.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Foreign military personnel temporarily serving” and ends with “in Kansas from age sixteen”?
cards.back: Foreign military personnel temporarily serving with the Armed Forces, and their spouses or children, may drive on a valid license in Kansas from age sixteen.
